key: 前3秒完整显示，随后小提示；10秒后释放亮屏保持，随后按系统息屏。短按暂停/继续，长按停止并退出（TFP1-04）；手机断连也可操作。抬头需开启原厂头控；到时空闲才提醒。重启眼镜会中断本轮计时。
en: Show the full timer for the first 3 seconds, then a small hint; release the keep-awake setting after 10 seconds and follow the system screen-off timer. Short press to pause/resume; long press to stop and exit (TFP1-04). Works even when the phone disconnects. Raise-to-wake requires the factory head-control feature. When time is up, alerts appear only while the glasses are idle. Restarting the glasses interrupts this timer.

en: Bluetooth disconnected; camera stopped. It will not resume capture automatically.

key: 表冠和四个屏幕按钮控制当前页面。息屏时第一次仅唤醒。退出手表页面即停；不保证锁屏/后台采样。升级、支付、恢复出厂等页面不开放，断连或忙碌不排队。
en: The crown and four screen buttons control the current page. When the display is off, the first press only wakes it. Control stops when you leave the Watch page; lock-screen and background sampling are not guaranteed. Pages such as update, payment, and factory reset are unavailable. Actions are not queued while disconnected or busy.

key: 表冠翻项，屏幕和手势确认/返回。需 TGR1 固件；未握手不会发送按键。
en: Use the crown to move between items; confirm or go back with the screen or gestures. Requires TGR1 firmware; no button press is sent before a handshake.

en: Requires iOS 26 or later and the complete LOCAL-TRANSLATION-PHONE-01 private package. Existing voice and captions were not taken over.

key: 音乐、读书、番茄、导航、滴滴和小应用不再仅因后台智记开关开启而被拒绝。前台应用占用和助手活动检查仍保留；真实采集、音频资源与唤醒共存需要实机验证。不是纯原厂固件；刷写可能失败，不保证救砖。
en: Music, reading, Focus timer, Navigation, DiDi, and small apps are no longer blocked solely because background Lifelog is enabled. Foreground app occupancy and assistant activity checks remain. Coexistence of actual capture, audio resources, and wake behavior still needs on-device verification. This is not stock firmware; flashing may fail, and recovery from bricking is not guaranteed.

en: Advanced features are here; the main screen stays simple. Breaks and quick checks are for glasses mode only. An existing timer will not be replaced.
